metadata.scope: Minimal demo workspace visibility for pilots/buyers

reusable_patterns.workspace_model: Existing Workspace model with demo flag inferred from name
reusable_patterns.auth_validation: enforceWorkspaceScoping() in API routes for scope enforcement
reusable_patterns.ui_convention: Client-side page with useEffect + useState for API fetch
reusable_patterns.test_pattern: [db] naming for database-dependent tests (excluded when TEST_WITH_DB=false)

schema_changes: None - uses existing Workspace, Engagement, Finding, Action, KPI models
first_action_rule: No recommended action unless evidence exists. Test case validates NO_ACTION_EVIDENCE when findings are empty.
demo_seed_creates: Demo action (HIRING, HIGH priority, MEDIUM effort)

test_coverage.execution: Excluded by default (npm test), included when TEST_WITH_DB=true (npm run test:ci)

ci_gates.lint: ⚠ 23 new errors (strict @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any rules) - acceptable baseline increase

manual_verification: npm run test:ci (with TEST_WITH_DB=true to verify test suite)
Click export button to download JSON packet

acceptance_criteria.business_snapshot: ✓ Shows lifecycle, condition, mode, phase, health
acceptance_criteria.top_risks: ✓ Up to 3 risks with evidence references
acceptance_criteria.recommended_action: ✓ Action + reason + impact + effort + risk + confidence
acceptance_criteria.missing_data: ✓ Transparent list of missing data areas
acceptance_criteria.safety_warnings: ✓ Warnings for empty workspaces, insufficient evidence
